newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was very slow late Friday. There were not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test, few sales ended steady.

Inquiry was moderate, demand was rather light. Feedlots current. Sales confirmed on 1,100 slaughter steers and 700 slaughter heifers. Last week's confirmed sales 88,800 head including 16,500 head or about 19 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Steers - few select and choice 2-3 1200 lbs 67.00.
Heifers - few select and choice 2-3 1000-1110 lbs 66.50-67.00.
